verdict.line: You lose if you facecheck a Cannon-stance Jayce with his Acceleration Gate up before level 6; you win the lane and every teamfight after Heartsteel and Warmog's come online.

brief.thesis: Jayce out-ranges you and his Acceleration Gate (E, Cannon stance) boosts Shock Blast (Q, Cannon stance) range and damage once he has points in both, giving him the lane and solo-kill edge the data shows. But Mundo's Adrenaline Rush passive plus a 975-range Q lets you farm and chip him back without ever walking into his kill zone, and the measured 52.8% win rate over 354 games says the health-stacking build eventually buries his poke.

theirWindow.when: Cannon stance with E (Acceleration Gate) ready
theirWindow.what: He can drop the gate and fire Shock Blast through it for extended range and bonus damage. Stay behind minions and don't push past the wave when you see the gate drop near him.

yourWindow.when: Jayce swaps to Hammer stance to last-hit
yourWindow.what: Hammer stance drops his threat range to 600 (Q leap) and 240 (E knockback). Walk up and throw Q (Infected Cleaver) at 975 range before he can swap back and punish him for free.

powerCurve.note: Ranged poke, his combo not online yet
Masochism burst and boots close the gap

start.why: Runs at 50.3% over 294 games and is the 71.7% pick for this exact reason: it blunts Jayce's poke autos and stacks with Adrenaline Rush so he can't whittle you down pre-6.

boots.why: Best winrate option (52.9% over 210 games) and lets you close the distance on a kiting ranged laner instead of eating free poke while you walk up.

core.why: First item on the highest-winrate path (64.7% over 34 games); stacks max health that directly scales your Q damage.
Turns Adrenaline Rush into real sustain, letting you out-regen his poke damage over the course of the lane.
Completes the 64.7% winrate path and adds magic resist against his E knockback and transform-bonus magic damage.

situational.when: you want more wave-clear and poke-back damage to answer his range
jayce or their team stacks crit or sustained auto-attack damage
you need more frontline tankiness for teamfights

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the melee trades you're forced into by his poke, healing you off every auto you land while he's in range.

summoners.why: This combo runs highest winrate (54.8%) and highest pick rate (43.8%). Teleport lets you reset after shoving with Q range instead of walking back into poke, and Flash dodges Shock Blast or the E knockback when he commits to an all-in.

playing.title: Farm with Q at max range
playing.detail: Infected Cleaver's 975 range outreaches his Q and Shock Blast. Clear waves and poke him from outside his kill zone instead of trading melee.

playing.title: Track his stance swap
playing.detail: Hextech Capacitor gives him a move speed burst every time he swaps weapons. A sudden speed-up means he's either engaging or about to disengage after poking.

playing.title: Respect the Gate-Blast combo
playing.detail: Once he has points in Cannon-stance Q and E, the Acceleration Gate boosts Shock Blast's range and damage. Don't push past the minion wave when you see the gate deployed.

playing.title: Save E for low-health trades
playing.detail: Masochism's AD gain scales with missing health, so it hits hardest after you've already taken poke. Engage once you're chunked, not before.

playing.title: Only burn W in melee range
playing.detail: Burning Agony drains your own health and only has 325 range, so it's dead weight until you're actually locked into a trade.

playing.title: Time R for skirmishes
playing.detail: Sadism's 75s cooldown means you can't spam it. Pop it to close the gap on a kiting Jayce or to out-sustain his all-in burst in an extended fight.

playing.title: Stack health, not damage
playing.detail: Your Q scales off his max health, not yours, so pure health items from Heartsteel into Warmog's both keep you alive and keep your poke relevant.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own read of the kits.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit by Jayce’s ranged pokes! Use [Q] to farm while using Doran’s Shield. Wait for your jungler to gank.
